title: LuyuBaubles
description: This mod contains a few accessories to facilitate the survival of players or modpacks.
body:
This mod adds 9 accessories that are slightly over-the-top.  
Players cannot craft them, and there are no loot drop methods—they are only obtainable via creative mode.  

- Oath · Wild Mulberry: Repairs durability of equipped and held items by +1 per second.  
- Floating Dust · Beyond Life: Grants a large maximum health increase, prevents death once (can withstand `/kill`), and instantly teleports the player to the spawn point upon "death" without counting as a true death.  
- Clear Water · Frugality: The higher the saturation and hunger values, the higher the defense.  
- Late Spring · White Jade: Deducts 99% of the enemy's health while also deducting 99% of the user's max health. Does not trigger if the user's health is below 15%.  
- Rations · Ice-Cold*: Each time a creature is defeated, randomly grants a permanent bonus to one of the following: attack damage, defense, attack speed, interaction range, or attack range. Can be used up to 2000 times.  
- Bamboo · Banishment: Press the C key to target a creature; 32 random locations within 0–10,000 blocks are selected. If placement is invalid, banishment fails. If successful, the creature is banished with no usage or time limits.  
- Savior · Inscription: Each time a villager is healed, increases the player's maximum health and defense permanently, with no upper limit.  
- Silver · Star: Press the X key to release a spherical field with a 32-block radius. All blocks within are turned into glass, and all non-boss creatures inside are instantly killed.  
- Muntjac in a Box: Grants random levels (0–10) of Strength, Speed, Resistance, Regeneration, Saturation, Wither (on attack), and Life Steal (1%–35%, corresponding to levels 0–8). Each effect is independent. Every second, there is a 3% chance to gain one of these effects, lasting 3 minutes. 

The mod also adds a new accessory slot called "Signature."

本模组添加了 9个主要饰品，有些超标；3个普通饰品。

玩家暂时无法在生存模式中获得它们，目前仅能通过创造模式获得。

誓约·柘：每秒修复物品栏以及双手的物品耐久 +1；

浮尘·往生：添加高额生命值上限，免死一次，能抗 /kill，受到致死伤害时不会死亡，而是传送回到复活点；

白水·节衣缩食：饥饿值和饱和度越高，防御力越高，暴击率和暴击伤害越高；

槐序·白玉：扣除敌人 99% 生命值的同时扣除自身 99% 血量上限，自身血量低于 15% 时不触发；

口粮·冰凌凌：每击败一个生物，在 攻击力/防御力/攻击速度/交互距离/攻击距离 中随机选中一个加成永久生效，一共可以使用 2000 次；

竺·逐：光标对准某个生物后按下 C 键，将会随机在 0 ~ 10000 格内随机选择 32 个格子试图放逐该生物，若成功选择到格子则将该生物放逐（有可能因选择失败而无法放逐），没有使用次数和冷却限制；

救世主·铭：每将一个僵尸村民治疗为村民便可以增加自身生命值和防御力上限，无上限；

银·星：按下 X 键后会释放出一个半径 32 范围的球形领域，领域内所有方块将被转化为玻璃，同时该领域内除 BOSS 外的生物将被清除；

盒子里的猹：力量 0～10 级，速度 0～10 级，抗性提升 0～10 级，再生 0～10 级，饱和，（攻击时）凋零 0～10 级，吸血 1%～35%（0～8 级），每个效果独立，每秒有 3% 概率获得其中一个，时效 3 分钟。

折弯的胡萝卜：10%生命值，6魔法伤害

云朵剑鞘：跳跃提升2，16%攻击伤害

小铃铛：3攻击力

模组还添加了新的饰品栏，“签名”。
